node.title: The sharp FPC5 cofactor cross determinant is an exact gcd-owner coordinate
node.statement: Fix one exact sharp rate-half M=4,t=2 anchor. Dividing its cross-cofactor determinant with any guarded monic point by the forced background locator gives a degree-at-most-(ell-3) polynomial E. This is an affine bijection from the complete guarded monic slice, and for every distinct exact contributor gcd(E,F_0)=gcd(F,F_0). Thus E directly realizes the balanced determinant common-error owner. The split-point and aggregate owner count remain open.
